paras: Application: Toyota 86 / GT86 (2012-2021), Subaru BRZ (2012-2020), Scion FR-S (2012-2016) Part Type: Billet aluminium fuel pump hanger – pumps not included Part Number: 20-1073

The Radium Fuel Pump Hanger replaces the factory in-tank fuel pump module on the first-generation Toyota 86 / Subaru BRZ / Scion FR-S and supports one or two aftermarket fuel pumps while retaining the OEM fuel level sender.
hl: Verified Pumps: Walbro F90000267 / F90000274 / F90000285, DeatschWerks DW440, Fuelab 49614, Protec 11928
Single or Dual Pumps: Replaces the factory in-tank module and supports one or two aftermarket pumps
OEM Sender Retained: Factory fuel level sender reused
Collector Box: One-piece anodised aluminium box with 355 LPH one-way fill valve
Redesigned Venturi: Jet pump siphon with reduced return restriction
Single Merged Outlet: Pumps merge to one 8AN ORB pump-out port
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Pump Hanger for Subaru BRZ / Toyota 86 2012-2021
